sections: Intuition — How far the grand mean is from a perfect fit
Definition — Deviance of the model with no covariates
Properties — Binary data, and a zero saturated log-likelihood
Worked example — Four binary observations, three of them ones
Connections — Residual deviance, degrees of freedom, and the likelihood ratio
sources_read: R documentation for glm, entries null.deviance and df.null, https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/stats/html/glm.html
proofs: For Bernoulli data the saturated log-likelihood is 0, so the null deviance is -2 times the intercept-only log-likelihood at p-hat = y-bar.
